prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—case complexity, location, cost, and how comfortable you feel with the doctor all matter. Based on the information available, **Buckhead Orthodontics** is a strong place to start: Dr. Michael Everson is board-certified, and the practice offers traditional braces and clear aligners. It’s at **2385 Peachtree Rd**; call **(404) 697-7497**.

For another option, **West Paces Ferry Orthodontics** has board-certified orthodontists and offers braces and Invisalign at **1218 West Paces Ferry Rd NW**; **(404) 262-2212**.

I’d book consultations with two or three practices before deciding. Ask who will supervise your treatment, what options fit your case, the full cost and retainer plan, and how emergencies or missed appointments are handled. A consultation can also help you judge whether the treatment plan is clear and whether you feel comfortable with the orthodontist.
